sources.text: Chamo-me Ana. Eu trabalho há três anos num lar em Leeds; comecei em outubro de 2023. Tenho a formação da medicação e faço a medication round da manhã para 18 residentes. No fim do turno, escrevo as daily notes em inglês e assino a folha da medicação. Antes do turno, leio o care plan de cada residente e faço o que lá está. Tenho a formação de moving and handling, uso a grua e trabalhamos sempre em dupla. Na unidade de demência, os residentes ficavam agitados ao fim do dia, por isso nós, a equipa toda, passámos o jantar para mais cedo. Eu fiz cartões com fotografias da comida, para cada pessoa poder apontar o que quer comer. Fiz três anos de noites, e também fins de semana. Uma noite, vi uma nódoa negra no braço de uma residente. Registei e contei logo à enfermeira de serviço, e ela fez a participação de safeguarding.

Para mim, dignidade é bater à porta antes de entrar, explicar o que vou fazer antes da higiene pessoal e fechar sempre as cortinas. E respeito a cultura e a religião de cada pessoa: pergunto o que quer comer, como quer ser tratada e se prefere ser ajudada por uma mulher.
Correção, os turnos da noite foram dois anos, não três, no último ano passei a fazer dias.

requirements.text: Awareness and understanding of how Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Dignity & Respect, and Human Rights will apply to this role.
Knowledge of keeping people safe from harm or abuse.
Knowledge of long term health & social care conditions e.g. cognitive impairment, Dementia, physical, learning and sensory disabilities
Ability to understand health care and social care assessments and support plans.
Ability to complete daily and medication record sheets
Ability to work with others in a team.
Ability to use own initiative to find solutions for routine day to day service delivery problems
Requirement to work evenings and weekends on a rota basis as part of 24 hour/ 7 day service

I have worked for 3 years in a care home in Leeds, starting in October 2023. I knock on the door before entering. I explain what I am going to do before personal hygiene. I always close the curtains. I respect each person's culture and religion. I ask what the person wants to eat. I ask how the person wants to be treated. I ask if the person prefers to be helped by a woman.

One night, I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and told the nurse on duty straight away. She made the safeguarding referral. In the dementia unit, residents became agitated late in the day, so we, the whole team, moved dinner earlier. I made cards with photographs of food, so each person could point to what they want to eat.

I have moving and handling training and use the hoist. We always work in a pair. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is in it. At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet. I did night shifts for 2 years, and in the last year I moved to days.

documents.title: Cover letter
documents.text:
Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,

I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.

I have worked for 3 years in a care home in Leeds, and I started in October 2023. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is in it. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for 18 residents. At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet. I have moving and handling training and use the hoist. We always work in a pair.

I did night shifts for 2 years, and in the last year I moved to days. In the dementia unit, residents became agitated late in the day, so we, the whole team, moved dinner earlier. I made cards with photographs of food, so each person could point to what they want to eat. One night, I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and told the nurse on duty straight away. She made the safeguarding referral.

I knock on the door before entering. I explain what I am going to do before personal hygiene. I always close the curtains. I respect each person's culture and religion. I ask what the person wants to eat. I ask how the person wants to be treated. I ask if the person prefers to be helped by a woman.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely, Ana
